Subscript and superscript elements are preserved in output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>H<sub>2</sub>O and E=mc<sup>2</sup></p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
```
